¡°overlapcode¡± represent different situations that selected region overlap with genes.									
1: gene contained within region.									
2: region contained within gene.									
3: region overlaps 5¡¯-end of genes.									
4: region overlaps 3¡¯-end of genes.									
5: the 3¡¯-end of genes is within 1kb of region.									
6: the 5¡¯-end of genes is within 1kb of region									
7:the 3¡¯-end of genes is within 180kb of region (only show the nearest one)									
8:the 5¡¯-end of genes is within 180kb of region (only show the nearest one)									
"geneID represent gene symbol as the order of ""transcpt"","">"" represent this is the nearest gene locate in the 180kb downstream of the selected region.""<""represent this is the nearest gene locate in the 180kb upstream of the selected region."
